params.caption: 🎮 Rockstar devs fear layoffs right after GTA 6's huge launch A Rockstar Games developer says he and his colleagues are worried about losing their jobs now that GTA 6 is out. The fear comes despite a launch that is already a hit: the game took years and more than a billion dollars to make, is one of the highest-rated games ever, and is expected to rank among the best-selling games of all time. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 14:24 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Dexerto · Eurogamer 👥 @RockstarGames 😟 React if this worries you too · 💬 Should studios keep teams after a mega launch? #GTA6 #RockstarGames #GameDev #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
